title: MV changing name box skin mid-game

posts.author: sorbecci
posts.body:
hi! so i have a section in my game where the window skin is changed mid-game once you reach a certain point. I did this by using the script call "$gameSystem.setWindowskin( "Window_2" ). It worked perfectly, but I also have the yanfly message core plugin and i use name boxes in the game. using the script call earlier changes the window skin but not the name box! is there a way i can have them both change?
thank you!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body: You would have to look through your plugins, and perhaps ask the author of one; that script call doesn't exist in MV's code. (neither does "Window_2")

posts.author: I_LIKE_BREAD7
posts.body:
I don't know if you would like to use this, but I made a plugin for changing the windowskin using an in-game variable.
I made it for my own purposes, so it doesn't have any other features and I only tested it with the plugins I used in the game I made it for, but it worked with yanfly message core and nameboxes.
You can get it here
rpg-maker-stuff/mv/ILB_MakeWindowskinChangeableByVariable.js at main · ILikeBread7/rpg-maker-stuff
Some RPG Maker plugins I made. Contribute to ILikeBread7/rpg-maker-stuff development by creating an account on GitHub.
github.com
It's released under a permissive license (MIT) so you can use it however you want.
Also if the $gameSystem.setWindowskin function is a part of another plugin you could try putting that plugin above or below yanfly's plugin.
Sometimes different plugins have weird interactions and might need to be included before or after another plugin to work properly together.
